## FSLogix operations
Profile share capacity and latency (Azure Monitor metrics, 30 days), FSLogix errors from the hosts, sign-in duration and share request failures. Queries match `az-avd/kql`.

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Source == "Microsoft-FSLogix-Apps" and EventLevelName in ("Error", "Warning")
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| summarize Errors = countif(EventLevelName == "Error"), Warnings = countif(EventLevelName == "Warning"), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| order by Errors desc
content.title: FSLogix errors by host

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Source == "Microsoft-FSLogix-Apps" and EventLevelName == "Error"
| where Computer startswith "__HOST_PREFIX__"
| extend Message = substring(RenderedDescription, 0, 200)
| summarize Count = count(), Hosts = dcount(Computer), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by EventID, Message
| order by Count desc
content.title: Most frequent FSLogix errors

content.query:
WVDConnections
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where State in ("Started", "Connected")
| summarize Started = minif(TimeGenerated, State == "Started"), Connected = minif(TimeGenerated, State == "Connected") by CorrelationId, UserName, SessionHostName
| where isnotempty(Connected)
| extend Seconds = datetime_diff("second", Connected, Started)
| summarize Connections = count(), P50 = percentile(Seconds, 50), P95 = percentile(Seconds, 95), Max = max(Seconds) by UserName
| order by P95 desc
content.title: Sign-in duration by user

content.query:
StorageFileLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where AccountName == "__STORAGE_ACCOUNT__"
| summarize Requests = count(),
            Failed = countif(StatusCode >= 400),
            Throttled = countif(StatusText has "Throttl" or StatusCode == 503),
            AuthFailures = countif(StatusCode == 403),
            AvgServerLatencyMs = avg(ServerLatencyMs),
            P95DurationMs = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Profile share requests per hour

content.query:
StorageFileLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where AccountName == "__STORAGE_ACCOUNT__" and StatusCode == 403
| summarize Count = count(), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by CallerIpAddress, AuthenticationType, StatusText, OperationName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Profile share authorization failures
